models.description: Population-oracle sequence-distilled recurrent cop, retrained under the PRODUCTION observation (COPTHIEF_UNIFORM_BELIEF=1 COPTHIEF_WIRE_SCENT=1). 180/270 wins at scent=wire/belief=prod over the nine scripted families (scripts/eval_candidate.py, seed 20260809). Supersedes cop_population_oracle_champion.pt, whose 0.9608 was measured against the UNCLAMPED trainer scent field and scored only 0.3185 (86/270) on this wire-faithful harness. Behaviourally a trapper: places barriers on ~7% of actions and waits, rather than tracking. CAVEAT: evaluation_win_rate is wire-faithful and NOT comparable to pre-2026-08-09 manifest figures; fixed starts plus argmax mean 30 games per family is 6 distinct games.
